name: codex-auto-continue
description: Continue interrupted Codex sessions automatically after usage limits reset. Arms a thread, waits for the account's real quota window to reset, then sends the continuation message via the Codex app and verifies a new turn started.

interface.shortDescription: Resume Codex sessions when the usage limit resets
interface.longDescription: When Codex hits its usage limit mid-task, this plugin arms the interrupted session and schedules a continuation for the moment the account's quota window resets (read from the Codex app server, 5h and weekly windows). At that time it sends the continuation message through the Codex app, verifies that a new turn actually started, and cleans up after itself. Sessions are only resumed when the user explicitly arms them.
